offensive.name: Sentence
offensive.description: The city does not strike you. It finds you guilty, and the striking follows.

tiers.text: The damage becomes force and gains +2 dice. One additional die if the target has broken an Edict of yours or attacked within one of your Structures.
tiers.card: +2 dice force · +1 more if they broke an Edict or attacked inside your Structure

tiers.text: +4 dice. The target cannot issue commands, rally allies, or use Intimidation until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: +4 dice · no commands, rallying or Intimidation until end of their next turn

tiers.text: +6 dice. Every creature that attacked alongside the target this round and is within 30 feet takes half this damage — the verdict names accomplices.
tiers.card: +6 dice · everyone who attacked alongside them within 30 ft takes half — the verdict names accomplices

tiers.text: +8 dice. The target is declared Outlaw for 1 minute: every attack against it by any creature deals an extra 1d8 force damage, and it cannot benefit from cover inside any settlement or Structure.
tiers.card: +8 dice · Outlaw 1 min — every attack against them adds 1d8 force, and no cover in any settlement

supportive.name: Communal Resonance
supportive.description: You bind effects into the lattice of a society's presence.

tiers.text: When an effect targets multiple creatures, designate one focal creature. Allies within 10 feet of that creature gain the spell's benefits if they weren't originally targeted.
tiers.card: Name a focal creature — allies within 10 ft of them gain the effect too

tiers.text: Allies that begin their turn within 30 feet of the focal creature gain a lesser version of the effect — half healing, partial buff, or temporary resistance.
tiers.card: Allies starting their turn within 30 ft of the focus get a lesser version

tiers.text: Allies that enter the range mid-effect automatically receive the full benefit, and may transfer it onward if they move within range of another ally.
tiers.card: Allies entering mid-effect get the full benefit and can pass it onward

tiers.text: Create a Civic Aura — for 1 minute, all allies within 60 feet of the focal creature are treated as if under the original spell's full effect, even if they leave and return. If the focal creature dies, the aura transfers to the nearest ally automatically.
tiers.card: Civic Aura 1 min — every ally within 60 ft of the focus counts as fully affected, coming and going

supportive.name: Structured Weave
supportive.description: Law gives the spell its spine — and law does not expire. (Complement effect used as Core)

tiers.text: The primary effect's duration is extended by 50%. If the effect requires Concentration, you may reroll one failed Concentration check before it ends.
tiers.card: Duration +50% · reroll one failed Concentration check

tiers.text: The duration is instead doubled, and your Concentration on this effect cannot be broken by damage from opportunity attacks.
tiers.card: Duration doubled · Concentration can't be broken by opportunity-attack damage

tiers.text: If the primary effect has a duration of 10 minutes or longer, it becomes semi-permanent — lasting until you dismiss it, it is countered, or disrupted by a Cognition directly opposing Civilization.
tiers.card: Effects of 10 min or longer become semi-permanent until dismissed or countered

tiers.text: The spell becomes encoded law. If cast again in the same settlement it is automatically upcast by 1 spell level and cannot be counterspelled by creatures without the Civilization Cognition.
tiers.card: Encoded law — recast in the same settlement it upcasts itself by 1 and resists counterspell

control.name: Edict
control.description: Law does not ask. It declares. (Save: Charisma)

tiers.text: Declare a single restriction of one sentence or less. A creature that fails the save cannot willingly violate it until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Declare a one-sentence restriction — failures can't willingly break it until end of their next turn

tiers.text: The restriction lasts 1 minute on a failed save, with a repeat Charisma save at the end of each of their turns. It may now cover one action type (attack, cast a spell, use a reaction).
tiers.card: Lasts 1 min (Cha save each turn) · may now cover a whole action type

tiers.text: Declare two restrictions simultaneously. Creatures that fail cannot violate either. On a success they are still unable to act against you directly until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Two restrictions at once · even successes can't act against you directly next turn

tiers.text: The Edict becomes absolute law for 1 minute. Creatures that fail cannot violate the restriction by any means — magical or otherwise — and attempting to do so causes psychic damage equal to your Verum Modifier each time they try.
tiers.card: Absolute law 1 min — no means magical or otherwise breaks it, and trying costs psychic damage

creation.name: Infrastructure
creation.description: Civilization does not conquer land — it claims it.

tiers.text: Your creations are dressed stone and fitted timber. Structures gain +2 AC and may include a gate or passage that only creatures you name may use freely.
tiers.card: Creations are dressed stone · Structures +2 AC · gates only those you name may use

tiers.text: Your Structures have resistance to all damage except force and siege damage and are immune to decay, erosion, and time-based Cognitions. Constructs are civic wardens — they may take the Help action as a bonus action.
tiers.card: Resist all but force and siege · immune to decay and time effects · Constructs Help as a bonus action

tiers.text: Your creations are culturally significant — allies within 30 feet of a Structure gain +1 to spell save DCs and attack rolls while defending it. A Structure made with a 6th-level slot or higher is permanent until destroyed or dismissed.
tiers.card: Culturally significant — allies within 30 ft get +1 DC and attack while defending · 6th+ is permanent

tiers.text: A Civic Fortification — the Structure is recognized as sovereign territory. Creatures of Intelligence 8 or higher instinctively understand this. Hostile creatures that enter must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Verum DC or be Frightened for 1 minute, and any creature that spends a minute within it learns a piece of its lore as Legend Lore.
tiers.card: Civic Fortification — sovereign territory · hostiles entering Cha save or Frightened · its lore is legible

utility.name: Common Tongue
utility.description: The most powerful thing in the world is a precedent.

tiers.text: Speak, read, and write any language of a settled people for 1 hour. Know the laws and customs of the place you stand in. Produce a document, seal, or writ indistinguishable from an authentic one.
tiers.card: Speak, read and write any settled language 1 hr · know local law · forge any authentic-looking writ

tiers.text: Be understood by every creature within 300 feet that can hear you, each in its own tongue. Learn the true history and ownership of a building, road, or border you touch.
tiers.card: Understood by everyone within 300 ft in their own tongue · read a building's true history and owner

tiers.text: Send your voice to every creature in a settlement you have entered. Record a statement into stone or parchment so that it cannot be altered, forged, or destroyed by nonmagical means.
tiers.card: Send your voice through a whole settlement · record a statement nothing mundane can alter or destroy

tiers.text: Declare a law over a settlement for 24 hours — every inhabitant knows it, and those who break it are known to you. Or read the full civic record of a ruin: who lived, who ruled, and how it fell.
tiers.card: Declare a law over a settlement 24 hrs — all know it, breakers are known to you · or read a ruin's full record

complementEffects.name: Iron Law
complementEffects.description: Resistance to the spell is resistance to order itself — and order does not forgive.

effect.text: When a target fails their saving throw or is hit by the primary effect, they take bonus force damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), as the weight of civilization's authority bears down on them.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and the target has disadvantage on Charisma checks and saves until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · disadvantage on Cha checks and saves until end of their next turn

penalty.disadvantage: Charisma checks and saves until the end of their n

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and creatures that fail are also unable to issue commands, rally allies, or use Intimidation until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · also no commands, rallying or Intimidation

complementEffects.name: Civic Ward
complementEffects.description: The structure of civilization shields those who uphold it.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft: +2 AC until your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The ally also gains advantage on the next saving throw they make before the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Also advantage on their next save

buff.advantage: the next saving throw they make before the start o

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Choose two allies to receive this benefit, and the AC bonus increases to +3.

complementEffects.name: Order's Weight
complementEffects.description: Civilization imposes structure even on those who resist it.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw vs your Verum DC or be unable to take more than one action on their next turn.
effect.card: Cha save {DC} or they can't take more than one action next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target is also unable to use bonus actions on their next turn.
upgrades.card: Fail also costs them their bonus actions

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail cannot take reactions either until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Also no reactions until end of their next turn

complementEffects.name: Structured Weave
complementEffects.description: Law gives the spell its spine — and law does not expire.

effect.text: The primary effect's duration is extended by 50%. If the effect requires Concentration, you may reroll one failed Concentration check before the effect ends.
effect.card: Duration +50% · reroll one failed Concentration check

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The duration is instead doubled, and Concentration cannot be broken by damage from opportunity attacks.
upgrades.card: Duration doubled · Concentration holds through opportunity-attack damage

upgrades.text: Level 11+: If the primary effect has a duration of 10 minutes or longer, it becomes semi-permanent — lasting until dismissed or disrupted by an opposing Cognition.
upgrades.card: Effects of 10 min or longer become semi-permanent
